mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(SUM(today_all), 0) AS todayAll, IFNULL(SUM(today_process), 0) AS todayProcess, IFNULL(SUM(today_complete), 0) AS todayComplete, IFNULL(SUM(pendding_judged), 0) AS penddingJudged, IFNULL(SUM(pending_dispatched), 0) AS pendingDispatched, IFNULL(SUM(pedding_disposal), 0) AS peddingDisposal, IFNULL(SUM(pending_approve), 0) AS pendingApprove, IFNULL(SUM(pendding_leader_approve), 0) AS penddingLeaderApprove, IFNULL(SUM(overtime), 0) AS overtime FROM vm_statistics_event_num dataTable WHERE `year` = YEAR(NOW()) AND `month` = MONTH(NOW()) AND `day` = DAY(NOW()) ${param.dataScope}
SELECT count(*) as num FROM ${tableName} WHERE link_id in ('3', '4') AND (group_id = #{deptId} OR process_id = #{userId})

select
region_name as regionName, province_id as areaCode, province_id as provinceId,
region_name as regionName, city_id as areaCode, province_id as provinceId, city_id as cityId,
region_name as regionName, county_id as areaCode, province_id as provinceId, city_id as cityId, county_id as countyId,
street_name as regionName, street_id as areaCode, province_id as provinceId, city_id as cityId, county_id as countyId, street_id as streetId,
IFNULL(sum(warning_num), 0) as num from vm_statistics_event_area dataTable where province_id is not null
AND `year` = YEAR(NOW())
AND `year` = YEAR(NOW()) AND `month` = MONTH(NOW())
AND street_id IS NOT NULL AND street_id != ''
${param.dataScope} group by
province_id
city_id
county_id
street_id
order by num desc limit 5
